card.fires_on: The word "in" right after a drug effect or use, where a patient group or condition comes next (e.g. "symptoms in patients with"). Also fires on the middle of the drug name ropinirole.

modes.label: In before patients
modes.description: The word "in" after an effect, risk or outcome, introducing the population or condition it applies to.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: The middle piece of the drug name ropinirole.
